headline: V-0006 Mainostoimisto Kaarniala: all eight advertising invoices booked to IT services (7200) instead of Marketing (7100).
mechanism: A marketing agency whose only permitted account is 7100 (Marketing) has its entire year of campaign invoices manually posted by one clerk (U-204) to 7200 (IT services). It is a persistent miscoding, not fraud: EUR 36,934 of marketing spend is sitting in the wrong expense-by-nature line, understating Marketing and overstating IT services.

evidence.what: all 8 rows for V-0006, memo verbatim
evidence.figure: 8/8 posted to 7200; memos 'Mainoskampanja, syyskuu/lokakuu 2025'; vendor allowed_accounts=7100 only
V-0006 = 'Mainostoimisto Kaarniala Oy' (advertising agency), allowed 7100 (Marketing)
exactly 8 rows, all V-0006 - this is the only mapping breach in 50,000 lines

recommended_action: Recode the eight invoices from 7200 to 7100 and set V-0006's posting default to Marketing so the classification stops recurring.

headline: V-0008 Pulttitarvike: both of the vendor's orders billed twice at identical amounts under the same order number.
mechanism: The vendor's entire year is two orders, each invoiced twice for the exact same euro amount within a week, both invoices citing the same purchase order. That is the classic duplicate-billing fingerprint (identical amount + same order + no partial-delivery marker), not a staged delivery, which would carry different amounts and an 'osatoimitus' note.

evidence.figure: TXN004166 & TXN004816 both EUR 842.50, both 'Ostolasku, tilaus 358022', 4 days apart, inv 801524/801525
TXN027877 & TXN028688 both EUR 615.20, both 'Ostolasku, tilaus 358023', 7 days apart, inv 801526/801527

evidence.what: duplicate exposure if both are true duplicates
evidence.figure: recoverable half = 842.50 + 615.20 = EUR 1,457.70

recommended_action: Confirm a single goods receipt exists for orders 358022 and 358023 and recover the duplicate half if only one delivery was received.

headline: V-0011 Sailiopalvelu: six steel invoices land on exact round thousands, implausible for per-tonne pricing.
mechanism: Six bimonthly invoices for steel and metal products (account 4100) are each an exact EUR 1,000 multiple, ramping 5k-6k-7k-8k-9k then 6k. Per-tonne steel does not land on round thousands six times running; the amounts look set by hand (estimate, advance, or fixed draw) rather than measured quantity. It cannot be stood down on the ledger alone because no contract or PO basis is visible.

evidence.figure: only V-0011 (6 rows) and V-0016 (rent, 12 rows) - V-0011 is the only non-rent round-sum vendor

recommended_action: Ask AP to match these six invoices to purchase orders or a supply agreement and confirm they reflect delivered quantities, not round estimates.

headline: V-0012 Ratashuolto: all four quarterly freight invoices sit just below the EUR 10,000 approval tier.
mechanism: The vendor's only four invoices, one per quarter, all fall in EUR 9,580-9,900 - the top 5% band immediately under the EUR 10,000 department-head approval threshold. The tiny spread (EUR 320) and one value at 9,899.99 mean the EUR 10,000 control is never triggered on a EUR 38.8k/yr freight relationship. Whether the sizing is the vendor's or internal, the approval tier is being skirted.

evidence.figure: exactly 4 rows, all V-0012 - no other vendor hugs the threshold

recommended_action: Verify the four freight bills reflect actual carriage and review whether this vendor's invoicing is being kept under EUR 10,000 to avoid department-head sign-off.

headline: V-0013 Kantamateriaali: two split-delivery pairs summing over EUR 10,000 - but e-invoiced partial deliveries with natural amounts.

headline: One supplier (Karrenbach Dichtungstechnik GmbH) exists as three vendor masters with three different bank accounts - a live duplicate-payment and payment-diversion surface.
mechanism: V-0003, V-0004 and V-0005 share one VAT number (DE199283746) and one address (Beispielstrasse 14, Hamburg) but are three separate vendor records with three different IBANs and three spellings of the name (proper / 'Kaerrenbach' / ALL CAPS). Byte-different names slip past the name-hygiene rule. Three masters for one legal entity means duplicate-invoice controls keyed on vendor_id cannot see across them, and three bank accounts mean a payment could be routed to any of them - the classic fingerprint of a duplicate/re-added vendor and a payment-diversion risk.

evidence.figure: one VAT DE199283746 + one address across V-0003/4/5; IBANs DE05..7867, DE76..5008, DE54..4734; names 'Karrenbach', 'Kaerrenbach', 'KARRENBACH'

evidence.what: spend split across the three masters
evidence.figure: V-0003 EUR 23,651 (7 inv), V-0004 EUR 15,026 (5), V-0005 EUR 10,324 (3); combined EUR 49,001, all on account 4110; V-0004/V-0005 activity only starts April
no same-amount invoice within 15 days across the three ids yet - so no realised double payment, but the exposure is open

recommended_action: Confirm the three IBANs genuinely belong to Karrenbach, merge V-0003/4/5 into one master, and block payments on the duplicates before the next run.
